name: creality-cr-petg
description: Creality CR-PETG 1.75 mm FDM filament. Facts transcribed from the vendor Technical Data Sheet v1.0 archived in the vault (attributes.tds holds the rows verbatim, attributes.normalised the typed values with the page each came from). Two rows in the document carry labels that do not match their test criteria; they are kept verbatim and flagged under attributes.review. Spool identity fields are the RFID data the Creality K2 Plus CFS reported for the loaded spools. Proposed by OpenKnowledgeCore P0 on 2026-11-06; awaiting review.

spool_rfid.note: Fields as reported by the printer for CFS box MF003 slots 2 and 3 on 2026-11-06 (two spools, same tag data). 'pressure' is the field name on the tag data; believed to be the pressure-advance value of the Creality profile; not interpreted here.
spool_rfid.name: CR-PETG

tds.title: CR-PETG Filament Technical Data Sheet
tds.issued: not printed in the document; the mirror file name says 2021-11

storage.text: Dry and ventilated environment; not high temperature, sunny or humid conditions; use a dry box if not used up within a short time after opening.

normalised.note: Typed values derived from attributes.tds by transcription only; no unit conversion was applied. Each value names its page in the cited document. Two keys are named by their test criteria rather than the document's row label; see attributes.review.
normalised.shrinkage_note: The TDS says 'low shrinkage advantage of PLA' (page 1) and gives no number. A value must come from a calibration measurement in the studio ledger.

flags: document row 'GTT(Glass-transition temperature)' cites ASTM D648 / ISO 75-2 at 0.45 MPa, which is a heat-deflection test; recorded as heat_deflection_c, not Tg
document row 'Vicat Softening Temperature' has condition 210 °C / 2.16 kg and unit g/10 min, which is a melt index; recorded as melt_flow_rate_g_10min; no Vicat value is available
TDS gives no filament diameter; 1.75 mm comes from the store page title
mirror copy: the PDF was archived from SpoolScout's asset host, not from creality.com; Creality publishes no TDS download page as of 2026-11-06
